_comment: Street RBA calls (economists and strategists). Update when an institution changes its view. For each bank: next_meeting = the RBA decision date the call refers to; call = hike | no change | cut; next_change = {month: YYYY-MM, optional label for approximate timing e.g. 'Mid 2027', direction: hike | cut, size_bp, rate_after}; as_of = date of the source; sources = links, newest first (the call bubble on the page links to sources[0], so put the article the current call comes from first). Set call to null if the bank has not published a view for the next meeting.

banks.note: CBA changed its call after the Q3 CPI (28 Oct): now expects a 25bp November hike to 4.85% (previously a hold); Belinda Allen calls it 'an insurance hike' against energy and AI-investment inflation pressures; expects holds in December and February; cuts pencilled in for August and November 2027, with large uncertainty on timing

Westpac reaffirmed after the Q3 CPI (28 Oct): 'We reaffirm our expectation that the RBA Monetary Policy Board will again increase the cash rate at the November meeting' (to 4.85%), with some external members possibly dissenting; further hikes not the base case but risk of another, most likely in February, has increased; previously saw cuts from August 2027

NAB changed its call after the Q3 CPI (28 Oct): 'We now believe that the RBA will deliver a 25bp hike in November' (to 4.85%, previously a hold); expects the RBA to likely pause after November but remain 'a long way from declaring victory on inflation'; cut timing not restated (previously from August 2027)

ANZ reaffirmed after the Q3 CPI (28 Oct): 'Today's inflation data cements the case for the RBA to hike rates 25bp in November' (to 4.85%); expects upward revisions to RBA inflation forecasts in the November SoMP; previously saw cuts from November 2027

AMP weekly update (Diana Mousina, 23 Oct): 'we see the RBA debating the need for another rate increase in November but ultimately keeping rates unchanged'; 'We think the central bank is done' but risk of a hike in December or early 2027; a Q3 trimmed mean above 1% q/q would make a November hike likely; Oliver previously saw cuts not until late 2027

UBS (Stephen Wu, Tharenou's team, 28 Oct) reaffirmed a 25bp hike to 4.85%, most likely in November, with the 1.0% q/q Q3 trimmed mean the likely trigger; earlier (21 Oct) Tharenou flagged a split board could deliver 'a hawkish hold' setting up December; cuts previously seen from November 2027

Goldman (Andrew Boak's team) changed its call after Deputy Governor Hauser's 'clearly hawkish' speech (20 Oct): now expects a 25bp hike to 4.85% in November (previously a hold), citing a deteriorating inflation outlook; timing of first cut not published
Steve Campbell (head of cash strategies): November 'another likely hike'; RBA 'unlikely to stop at a single hike'
